title: Freática · el agua contenida en el motor
description: The contained water of Emilie's ánima in the effects lab over a fight at the campsite (?fxlab, src/freatica-fx.ts, src/freatica-lab.ts; docs/animas/freatica/README.md § Look and interface, docs/animas/README.md § Agua contenida). A straight cell round the foes with a staff gauge, water that wells up to three marks and whose colour is its depth, the current, the steam, the sinking and the cell breaking, and then each of the ánima's skills as it shows on the cell (Recarga, Sondeo eléctrico, Bombeo, Riada, Golpe de ariete, and its definitiva, Bajo cero: the ice, its cracks, its break and its turns). Only the look, never a fight's numbers. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: The cell draws itself in round the foes (its floor, its uprights, its top, then the gauge) and the water wells up from the ground, a mark at a time: I to the ankles and green, II to the waist, III over their heads and blue. At the third they are sunk and let go of bubbles
Agua I: a film of green water to the ankles, a ring round each foe, her model's mesh on the surface
Agua II: to the waist. The column goes from green at the surface to blue below
Agua III, Hundidos: the surface a hand over the tallest head, the gauge's three marks lit, strings of bubbles from each foe
Corriente: the bolt flashes through the whole volume, arcs skate over the surface and run along the cell's edges, and every two seconds the water flickers and sparks jump off each foe
The water carrying current at the third mark
Vapor: fire on the water. The slab between the surface and the mark below flashes white and goes up as steam; the water is at II at once and a cloud stays over the foes
After the steam: the water a mark lower, a notch on the gauge where it stood, the cloud at the height of their heads

The surface is the clock (ten times as fast here): within a mark it sinks from full to the mark's own tick, the pointer riding it down the gauge; the edge blinks at the end and it drops to the mark below, and from the first it drains out
The cell breaks (whoever held it has fallen): the edges go out from the top, the water falls and runs out over the floor
The first round: the cell's edges and its gauge in grey. The water is the same in both
Recarga: the tape runs out along the floor from whoever casts to the foe, water wells up through it and the level rises a mark
Sondeo eléctrico: a bolt from the caster's hands to the foe and down it into the water, which keeps the current
Bombeo: the water gives a mark up; it runs back along the floor and comes up round each of the party as green beads
Riada: a wave crosses the cell from the party's side, breaking on each foe, and the level rises two marks behind it
Golpe de ariete: the water is spent in blows, one a mark. Each is a white flash through the cell from its walls in as the level slams down a mark
Bajo cero, the definitiva: a white flash and the water is ice, a block round each foe to where the water stood. The cell is left empty between them, its edges brighter
Frozen at the third mark: neither can act. The gauge keeps the three marks: three turns of ice
Blows from outside: each opens cracks from the middle of every face out, and at the third the ice breaks in shards. The other foe is still in its own
One foe broken out of its ice, the other with its first cracks
A turn goes by and the ice comes down a mark: to the waist, then to the ankles. With the next it is gone, and the water with it
The whole fight: the party dry on its side, the foes sunk in live water on theirs
